$comment: Shillinq W8 — admin Vue UIs for the W2-E + W5-D dormant external-API adapter ports. Adds the 'External Connections' top-level nav node with one child per adapter family. The index page lists every family with a dormant/live badge; the detail page renders the activation steps + config keys + openconnector source slug + feature flag operators must wire up to bind a real implementation. Drives ExternalAdaptersAdminController#index / #show.

pages.title: External Adapter Status
pages._note: The adapter catalogue is a PHP-side registry served by externalAdaptersAdmin#index (/api/admin/external-adapters), not an OpenRegister register/schema — there is no object collection for `type: index` to bind config.register/config.schema to. Each row is also a live dormancy verdict computed per request from app-config keys and openconnector source presence, not a stored field, so a declarative column list cannot express it.

pages.title: Digipoort / SBR
pages._note: Digipoort/SBR activation console. `type: detail` resolves an OpenRegister object from config.register + config.schema + :id; this page has no object — it reads the adapter descriptor from externalAdaptersAdmin#show and renders the SBR activation checklist, the oc_appconfig keys the operator must set, and the openconnector source slug that binds the live implementation.

pages.title: Payroll bureau
pages._note: Payroll-bureau adapter console. Same reason as ExternalAdapterDigipoort: the payload is the adapter descriptor from externalAdaptersAdmin#show plus a computed dormant/live verdict, neither of which is an OpenRegister object, so `type: detail` has nothing to resolve.

pages.title: RvO
pages._note: RvO (subsidy portal) adapter console — adapter descriptor + activation checklist from externalAdaptersAdmin#show, not an OpenRegister object, so no standard object-bound page type applies.

pages.title: Belastingdienst IB47
pages._note: Belastingdienst IB47 adapter console — adapter descriptor + activation checklist from externalAdaptersAdmin#show, not an OpenRegister object. The IB47 DATA (the annual batch and its records) does have index/detail pages; this page is the transport binding, which does not.

pages.title: CBS files

pages.title: CBS Iv3
